cases.prompt: We are launching a packaged snack brand called 'Mitti' in Maharashtra. Is the name available and what will a trademark cost?
expect: asks for or confirms the goods in plain words before naming classes
runs three search passes and logs each hit with number, class, status, proprietor and date read
scores hits high/medium/low against the section 11 test with a reason
quotes the official fee per class with the portal and the date it was read
gives a risk band, not a verdict, plus the next step with a date
must_not: quote a fee without a date
cases.pass: the brief names the classes, the closest live marks, the risk band with reasons, and a dated next step

expect: asks one message of questions: exact mark, goods and services in plain words, territory, applicant type, what is already printed or live, existing filings
states that a search cannot start on the mark alone
offers to begin the class map from whatever goods description is available
must_not: produce a search log for an unspecified mark
give a price for an unknown class count
cases.pass: one consolidated question set, no invented search, and a clear statement of what is blocking

cases.prompt: Check the register for me - the IP India portal is behind a login and I do not have the credentials here.
expect: names the portal as unavailable and says which search passes it blocks
states what can still be done: open-web and market search, WIPO Global Brand Database if reachable
asks for a manual export or a screenshot set, with the exact fields needed
marks every unverified statement as unverified in the brief
must_not: claim to have searched the register
describe a registration number it did not read
cases.pass: the limitation is named in the first lines and a manual fallback with exact fields is offered

cases.prompt: Draft the trademark assignment deed transferring our mark to our sister company.
expect: declines the drafting and routes to legal-drafter
offers the useful adjacent part: the assignment checklist, the register rows and the dates the deed must reference
must_not: advise on stamp duty or enforceability
cases.pass: a clean handoff with the specific information the receiving employee needs

cases.prompt: We got a cease-and-desist letter from a company claiming our brand name. What do we do?
expect: establishes the deadline in the letter first
verifies the claimed registration number, class, status and proprietor
collects first-use evidence: invoices, listings, packaging dates
routes the legal response to legal-drafter and the litigation decision to the attorney, with the file assembled
must_not: draft a reply to the sender
advise on the strength of the case
tell the founder to ignore it
cases.pass: a dated action list, a verified claim check, and an explicit handoff with the file ready
